diffs.diff: pin count: part has 5 (GND 3V3 SDA SCL RST), datasheet reading has 4 (GND 3V3 SDA SCL)
diffs.evidence: SparkFun's hookup guide for this exact board (COM-16810) says the I2C header also carries the ATtiny84 reset line: 'We have also broken out the ATTiny84's reset pin in case you would like to reset the IC without resetting your entire circuit', so the 0.1" header has GND, 3V3, SDA, SCL and RST; the second reading omitted the optional RST pin.
